mapper.sql: FROM user_wrong_question w JOIN question q ON q.id = w.question_id AND q.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN knowledge_point kp ON kp.id = q.knowledge_point_id LEFT JOIN submit_record s ON s.id = w.last_submit_id
mapper.select:
SELECT w.id, w.question_id, q.title, q.difficulty, q.knowledge_point_id, kp.code AS knowledge_point_code, kp.name AS knowledge_point_name, w.wrong_count, w.mastered, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM submit_record ac WHERE ac.user_id = w.user_id AND ac.question_id = w.question_id AND ac.status = 'AC' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS passed, w.last_wrong_time, s.id AS last_submit_id, s.status AS last_submit_status, LEFT(s.code, 200) AS last_submit_code
ORDER BY w.last_wrong_time DESC, w.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_wrong_question (user_id, question_id, wrong_count, last_submit_id, mastered, first_wrong_time, last_wrong_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{questionId}, 1, #{submitId}, 0, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE wrong_count = wrong_count + 1, last_submit_id = VALUES(last_submit_id), mastered = 0, mastered_time = NULL, last_wrong_time = NOW()
